summary: Ansible 14.4 community.crypto deprecates the select_crypto_backend option, to be removed in 4.0.0, in get_certificate, openssl_csr, openssl_csr_info, openssl_csr_pipe, openssl_pkcs12, openssl_privatekey, openssl_privatekey_info, openssl_privatekey_pipe and openssl_publickey.
